Then we need to provide estimated total payable amount. But we also need to consider booking? The user says "arrange a flight" but they want to check options. They want to compute cost. So we just compute cost. We might need to authenticate? The function get_flight_cost requires no auth. So we can call get_flight_cost. But we need to get the list of airports first. So call list_all_airports. Then get_flight_cost. Then provide estimated total payable amount. Possibly we need to consider insurance? Not mentioned. So just cost.

Thus we need to call list_all_airports. Then get_flight_cost. Then respond.
